notes: Probabilities are calibrated on held-out rows of the training file (temperature scaling). They describe the model, not proof, and can be less reliable on traffic that differs from the training data.
The 90% prediction set (shortlist) targets 90% coverage on average over flows like the calibration rows; it is not a per-flow guarantee, and a single-class set is not certainty.

Attack-STATUS uncertain: the shortlist contains Normal and at least one attack type (attack or not is unclear). Attack-TYPE uncertain: predicted attack and the shortlist has several attack types but not Normal.
Confidence, heuristic severity and business impact are different quantities.
shift_evidence: On the official test file (shifted from the training file) the detector flagged 27.2% of Normal flows as attacks (model card).
For the previous detector v2 the 90% sets contained the true class for 79.1% of official test flows (Notebook 21); this was not re-measured for v3.
